title: 孤立单元靠近边缘更吸睛
content: 一个孤立的单元靠近画面边缘时，其吸引力往往大于放在中心时，可据此安排边缘元素的视觉权重。
quote: An isolated unit near the edge has frequently more attraction than at the centre.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 对立线优于切线
content: 一组对立线比与之等价的切线更具画意（picturesqueness）。
quote: A series of oppositional lines has more picturesqueness than the tangent, its equivalent.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 避免等量物体分散视线
content: 不要让大量同等大小的物体同时出现，否则视线被分散；应通过大小、主次差异引导观看。
quote: that the eye may not be distracted by a multiplicity of objects of equal magnitude.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 画面平面与可测面
content: 与画面平面重合（或紧贴）的面既是透视图形又是几何图形，可直接用比例尺量取；离开画面平面的面只能按透视规则推算，不可直接量取。
quote: it is at the same time a perspective and a geometrical figure, and can therefore be measured with the compasses.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 关联单元合并计重
content: 两个或多个相互关联的单元可视为一个整体，其联合中心是与其它元素取得平衡的支点。
quote: Two or more associated units may be reckoned as one and their _united centre_ is the point on which they balance with others.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 跪姿头部避开中线
content: 两个站立人物配一个跪姿人物时，跪姿者的头部既不能与任一站立者头部同垂直线，也不能落在两者正中间。
quote: the head shall not come on the same vertical line as either of the other heads, or half-way between the two

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 交叉手臂忌直角
content: 两臂交叉是常见情形，交叉处不应形成直角；该处无需表达稳定不动感，故应避免直角的呆板形式。
quote: In the very frequent case of two arms crossing each other, they should not cross at right angles.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 明暗交界最强烈
content: 亮部与暗部相接处对比最强，明暗都在交界线上达到最饱和；布光时把最亮与最暗都压在交界处，而非各自区域的中心。
quote: Where light _joins_ darkness, the light and dark are most intense at their _junction_, arising from affinity of contrast.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 垂直线画法
content: 从基线给定点向灭点连线，即得与基线成直角的纵深线；可重复此法画出任意多条直角线，并需想象它们彼此平行。
quote: We simply draw a line along the ground to the point of sight _S_, and this line will be at right angles to the base

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 45°对角线与距点
content: 从基线给定点连向距点D，所得直线与基线成45°，即正方形对角线的角度；画正方形对角线时用距点而非主灭点。
quote: Draw a line from _P_ to the point of distance _D_ and this line _PD_ will be at an angle of 45 deg, or at the same angle as the diagonal of a square.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 圆与半径结构
content: 以圆加半径的方式组织画面：圆提供循环，半径提供指向与分割，二者结合控制视线路径。
quote: Circle and Radius

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 圆形观察法
content: 以圆形观察组织画面：把主体与陪体纳入一个圆形区域，视线在圆内循环，形成内聚构图。
quote: Triangular Composition--Circular Observation

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 线条多样与简洁并存
content: 优秀构图应把线条的多样变化与庄严的简洁结合起来，如拉斐尔《雅典学院》《帕纳塞斯》《神学》那样。
quote: Here we find variety of line combined with a dignified simplicity.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 破格须服务真实感
content: 允许大幅违反构图法则，但前提是这些破格有助于让场景显得真实；若不能增强真实感，就不该破格。
quote: he may take great liberties with the laws of composition, provided always these liberties tend to assist in giving reality to the scene.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 斜线灭点定位
content: 凡与地平线成非直角/非45°的斜线，其灭点落在水平线上其他位置；向上倾斜的线灭点在地平线之上，向下倾斜的线灭点在地平线之下，且都位于其地面投影灭点所在的竖直线上。
quote: Lines which incline upwards have their vanishing points above the horizon, and those which incline downwards, below it.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 垂直线交于视点
content: 凡与画面成直角的水平线，一律画向视点（心点）；这是透视中最重要的规则，可用穿过视点孔的两根细绳辅助演示。
quote: All horizontals which are at right angles to the picture plane are drawn to the point of sight.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 凸线前进凹线后退
content: 凸形线条通常与向前运动相关联，凹形线条与后退相关联；用轮廓线方向暗示人物或群体的运动方向。
quote: convex lines being almost always associated with forward movement, and concave with retreat

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 分组须成完整整体
content: 分组是把各部分组合成协调而轮廓明确的整体，必要时用最强对比；若形体过于散乱，会破坏艺术最可贵的和谐统一。
quote: Grouping, in composition, involves in its arrangement, a combination of the parts, so that they form an agreeable and well-defined whole

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 前景单元可更轻
content: 前景中的单元视觉重量可能小于远处同样的单元；需要让远处元素压住画面时，可把重元素放到远景。
quote: A unit in the foreground may have less weight than a like one in the distance.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 前景硬线引眼远景放松
content: 前景用切割感强的硬边线条吸引视线，同时让远景保持柔和松弛，形成前紧后松的对比，使眼睛被前景抓住后能在远处休息。
quote: The harsh opposition of the cutting-lines of the foreground serves to attract the eye, while it reposes the distance.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 轮廓线用暗部或底色
content: 勾画人物轮廓时，用阴影色或所在背景的颜色起稿，再依其位置关系逐步加强。
quote: The outlines of figures should be sketched with either the shadow-colour, or the colour of the ground, on which they are laid

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 肖像消除两侧空隙
content: 单人或肖像构图中，金字塔形可消解人物两侧的空隙，避免留下与画框平行的长四边形。
quote: the pyramidal form annihilates the spaces on either side of the figure

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 变化与繁复调动想象
content: 变化与繁复若运用得当有许多优点，能激发观者的想象力；但须以技巧加以控制。
quote: Variety and intricacy have many excellencies, when managed with skill, as they exert the imagination of the beholder.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 线条的承接与转向
content: 可让一个元素的线条承接并转向另一元素的线条（如把墙上阴影线引向地毯线），使画面线条连贯统一。
quote: catches and turns the line of the shadow on the wall into the line of the rug

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 同灭点即透视平行
content: 同一平面内、指向地平线上同一点的若干水平线，在透视中互为平行；画平行线组时统一收束到同一灭点即可。
quote: Horizontals in the same plane which are drawn to the same point on the horizon are perspectively parallel to each other.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 环境色改变主体观感
content: 同一颜色会因周围底色不同而显得不同：肤色在红底上最苍白，淡色在黄底上偏红，主体性格由周围色决定。
quote: Flesh will look palest on a red ground: and a pale colour, redder on a yellow ground

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 倾斜线的灭点规则
content: 向上倾斜的线，灭点在水平线之上；向下倾斜的线，灭点在水平线之下；两者都位于其水平投影灭点所在的竖直线上。画台阶、上下坡道路时用此规则。
quote: Lines which incline upwards have their vanishing points above the horizontal line, and those which incline downwards, below it.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 避免头部菱形排布
content: 四个头部不要构成菱形（lozenge）四边形，这种对称排布同样令人不适，应挪动其中一个头部的位置来打破。
quote: we have four heads suggesting a quadrilateral of lozenge shape

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 圆形构图与圆形观察
content: 圆形构图指那些明显以圆形观察方式组织画面的作品，即圆是构图的第一意念；而结构看似非圆形的画面中也可能存在圆形观察。
quote: _circular composition,_ or that class of pictures where the evident intention is to compose under the influence of circular observation

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 亮底暗块防成洞
content: 在亮背景上放暗色中心时，若不采用同样的边缘处理（保留硬边），暗块会看起来像一个洞。
quote: if a dark centre be placed on a light ground, if the same management be not observed, it will look like a hole.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 避免直角构图
content: 在人物组合的构图中避免出现直角；人物肢体、视线或群体走向不要形成90度的正交关系。
quote: The second rule to which I wish to call your attention is the avoidance of right angles in the composition of your figures.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 圆内十字结构
content: 在圆形构图中加入十字（垂直与水平交叉），用交叉点锚定视觉中心，兼顾循环与稳定。
quote: The Cross Within the Circle

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 对称的偏离限度
content: 在对称式构图中必须保留一定偏离量：偏离过少则构图呆板无生气，偏离过多则失去此类题材应有的对称感，把握这一限度正是画家的功力所在。
quote: A certain amount of deviation is necessary, and it is in fixing the limit of this deviation that the skill of the artist is shown.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 孤立单元更重
content: 在空旷空间中，单个视觉单元因孤立而比放在多个单元中时更具视觉重量；需要强调某主体时，可让它独自占据空间。
quote: A unit of attraction in an otherwise empty space has more weight through isolation than the same when placed with other units.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 配重勿过重
content: 在竖轴另一侧补配重时，容易用过重的元素；若整个主体已在一侧站稳，另一侧再加元素反而显得多余，应先判断是否真的需要补。
quote: in an attempt to create a balance on the opposite side of the vertical the tendency is to use too heavy a weight.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 地平线依题材定
content: 地平线高度与各视点要素须由题材性质决定，没有通用正确值：同一处理在此题材对、在彼题材错。
quote: you must allow yourselves to be guided by the nature of your subject. What is right in one case is wrong in another.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 垂直线与水平线的情绪
content: 垂直线用于表现行动、庄重、有节制的沉重感；水平线用于表现安静、休憩、平静、肃穆。构图时按所需情绪选择主导线方向。
quote: Vertical line in action; dignified, measured, ponderous

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 笔法要有宽度与力度
content: 处理画面时避免过度琐碎雕琢，笔法应保持宽阔、有力度（breadth and manliness），以支撑整体气势而非只求局部精巧。
quote: the execution wants that breadth and manliness which are so conspicuous in the best works of Meissonier

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 变化与单纯并重
content: 处理空景时以变化与单纯为首要原则，二者兼顾才能得到宏大感；只求变化或只求单纯都不成立。
quote: variety and simplicity should ever be their leading principle, and grandeur is sure to be the result.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 避免头部等距同圆
content: 多个头部不要等距排布在同一圆周上；即使朝向各异（正面、四分之三、侧面、背面），等距同圆仍显呆板，应移动其中一个头部打破对称。
quote: They are equidistant, and placed on a segment of the same circle

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 头部可同水平线
content: 多人物构图中，允许两个或多个头部处于同一水平线上，很多时候这样安排反而有利。
quote: There is no objection, in a composition of many figures, to placing two or more heads on the same horizontal line.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 头部排布宜错落
content: 头部应追求如画而不规则的排布，避免整齐对称；这是优秀设计中的显著特征。
quote: the extreme importance of a picturesque and irregular arrangement of the heads

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 主光避开画面中心
content: 安排主光位置时不要放在画面正中，应偏置到一侧，让明暗分布产生不对称的张力。
quote: The principal light must never be placed in the centre, but either on one side or other.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 头部避免几何图案
content: 安排多个人物的头部位置时，把头部当作视觉兴趣点来检查：不要让它们连成规则的几何形状（如等边三角形、直线、正方形），应错落分布。
quote: Be very careful about the relative position of the heads, so that viewed as points of interest they do not form any regular geometrical pattern.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 分离物体的明度渐变
content: 对彼此分离的物体，用明度值（values）的渐变把它们串成整体，避免画面散乱。
quote: Gradation through Values of Separated Objects

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 以对立破除规则形
content: 对规则形体的对立是必要的，这种对立称为“衬托”（Relief），用于避免画面过于规整呆板。
quote: _Opposition_ to regular forms is essential; this opposition is called Relief.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 对角配重与头部同侧
content: 对角两角的元素应互相配重；若两个重要头部（如人与动物）落在画面同一侧，会失衡，需在另一侧加重量或整体略向另一侧偏移。
quote: the diagonal corners then balance, but because the heads of both woman and dog are too important for the same side of the picture.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 金字塔式构图
content: 将主体置于金字塔结构的顶点，次要元素构成底边与侧边，使画面获得物理稳定感；人物画中可让大金字塔内嵌套小金字塔。
quote: The framework of both is the pyramid, or what is termed _the structure of physical stability._

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 连续线优于散点
content: 就吸引力而言，一条连续的线比一串孤立分散的物体更强。
quote: A line in its continuity is more attractive than a succession of isolated objects.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 平行透视视点可出画
content: 平行透视（一点透视）时，视点落在画面之外不会让观众感到别扭；表现小范围场景时，透视线汇聚于画外一点反而更悦目。
quote: Where the perspective is parallel, the eye is not at all shocked when the point of sight is fairly out of the picture.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 禁止头部同垂直线
content: 应避免多个头部落在同一条垂直线上；若前方有跪姿或坐姿人物、后方有站立人物，须错开使两头部不垂直对齐。
quote: what ought to be avoided is having heads on the same _vertical_ line

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 线优于面的取舍
content: 当同一冲动以棱角能量呈现时，线条比块面更具吸引力，构图可优先经营线而非面。
quote: Line Versus Space (The same impulse with angular energy, The line more attractive than the plane)

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 封闭空间强光适用模型
content: 当场景是封闭房间或牢房、且光线强烈集中时，用黏土模型预演明暗与人物安排尤其有效。
quote: This plan is particularly applicable whenever the scene of the picture is a confined room or cell, with a strong concentrated light.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 平行基线的线透视仍平行
content: 当所画直线与画面基线平行时，其透视也平行于基线，可直接按平行关系作线，无需逐点求透视。
keywords: 平行基线的线透视仍平行
quote: When the line required is parallel to the base line of the picture, then the perspective of it is also parallel to that base

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 装饰性外轮廓主导构图
content: 当构图由装饰性外轮廓线主导时，画面整体服从该外轮廓的走向，如格拉肯斯《和解》。
quote: Composition governed by the decorative exterior line

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 压背景而非提主体
content: 当画面中某物体位置不够明确时，优先压低其背景的强度，而不是提高该物体本身的颜色。
quote: instead of heightening the colour of it, it is generally more advisable, as the case may be, to subdue the power of its background.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 用竖线对抗横线
content: 当画面以桌子等横向线条为主时，可在相应位置放置竖直的人物或物体，用竖线对抗横线以稳定构图。
quote: It opposes its vertical to the horizontal of the table, and catches and turns the line of the shadow on the wall into the line of the rug.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 用水平线打断陡斜线
content: 当画面出现从肩部沿手臂直冲画外的陡斜线时，用一组持续的水平元素（桌面、椅子、地面投影）来分流这条线，避免视线被带出画外。
quote: In order to divert the precipitate line a persistence of horizontals was necessary—the table, the chair and the shadow on the floor.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 中轴平衡的两种解法
content: 当画面可沿中轴切分时，有两种成立方式：把中轴线移到主体中心，或拉长另一侧以取得更多空间重量来平衡主体。
quote: the opposing half may either be cut off without damage, or greatly elongated, and in both forms the picture seems to survive.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 引导线的等价物
content: 当画面缺少引导线时，可用对岸（远处）的吸引物作为引导线的等价物来补足构图。
quote: The equivalent therefore of the leading line is the object on the farther shore.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 暗底上的亮部要有形
content: 当画面背景以暗调为主时，亮部在构图中必须呈现某个明确、肯定的形状，因为亮部的意义只能靠自身形状来说明。
quote: When the ground of the picture is mostly dark, the lights, in my opinion, should take some one or other good decided _form_ in composition

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 截顶金字塔构图
content: 当画面需要表现理想化的集会或群体（如艺术殿堂式场景）时，可用截顶金字塔形，即顶部被削平的金字塔式群组。
quote: Sometimes the form is that of a truncated pyramid, as in the Hemicycle at the Ecole des Beaux Arts

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 凹形空间忌水平排头
content: 当空间侧边为曲线、尤其拱肩等凹形区域时，长直水平排列的头部会显得非常刺眼，应避免。
quote: Straight horizontal lines of heads which are generally so desirable for long rectilinear spaces here become very objectionable.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 斜线与曲线的运动感
content: 当线条倾斜而失去自我支撑、或转为弯曲时，画面即暗示运动，并唤起与垂直、水平不同的另一组情绪。
quote: But when the line slants and ceases to support itself, or becomes curved, movement is suggested and another set of emotions is evoked.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 反向摆动更需补足
content: 当船的线条向相反方向摆动时，引导线或对岸吸引物二者必居其一的需求更加明显。
quote: The necessity of either the one or the other is more clearly shown when the line from the boat swings in the opposite direction.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 距点过远用半距半基
content: 当距点远在画面之外无法使用时，改用半距点与半基线作图，所得交点与用全距全基完全一致。
quote: If the distance-point is a long way out of the picture, then the same result can be obtained by using the half distance and half base

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 背景可承担风景功能
content: 当风景只作为人物画的背景出现时，仍应把它当作画面的一部分来经营，而不是仅作填充；若想拍风景，应转向岩石、森林等宏大形式。
quote: I do not recollect any landscape work in the Spanish gallery except as backgrounds to the figure pictures.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 云影统一构图
content: 想让画面更宁静柔和时，把云层的暗部与构图主体连成一体，而不是让云与主体形成对立；统一比对抗更易得到 repose 与 softness。
quote: More _repose_ and softness is obtained by uniting the composition with the darker shadows of the clouds, than by opposition.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 用视觉点串成环形回路
content: 想让视线在画面中循环，可沿金字塔式主体布置一串高对比视觉点（手、手臂、鞭子、狗身斑点、狗前腿肘、另一只狗胸口的亮部、背景桌椅的亮部），使眼睛沿这些点绕行成环。
quote: around this a circuit is described by the hand, arm, crop, spot on dog’s side, elbow of dog’s foreleg, line of light on the other dog’s breast

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 附属物并入主组
content: 所有附属元素可并入主要组群，使其共同服务于画面的整体宽度与气势，而非各自为政。
quote: All accessories may be included in the principal group, so that they contribute to the general breadth.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 用对立元素削弱轴线
content: 找到轴线后，应在一侧或两侧用对立的线条或体量来削弱其力度，避免轴线过于强势而失衡。
quote: When the axis is found, its force should be modified by opposed lines or measures, on one or both sides.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 直线入透视即两点入透视
content: 把一条给定直线画入透视，等于分别求出其两端点的透视位置再连线；若一端落在基线上，则只需再求另一端一点即可。
quote: This is simply a question of putting two points into perspective, instead of one, or like doing the previous problem twice over

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 明暗分区求静
content: 把亮组/亮物放在画面亮侧、暗物放在暗侧，可获得最大的静谧感，因为两者互不干扰；但整体效果弱于把明暗互相穿插，且两部分更难统一。
quote: Most _repose_ is obtained by placing a light group or object on the light side of the picture, and dark objects on the dark side

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 移向中心削弱分量
content: 把对象移向画面中心，或在该侧扩展画面，都会削弱它在平衡体系中的吸引力分量。
quote: The attractive value of an object in the scale of balance may be weakened by moving it toward the centre or extending the picture on that side.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 暖光点状散布与呼应
content: 把暖色亮部做成散点：树梢、中景与前景的暖棕、天空下部各放一点，再在前景左侧的枝叶与草上加强，形成从天空到地面的暖色呼应链，避免暖色只集中在一处。
quote: The warm lights are scattered over the tops of the trees and sunny browns of the middle space and foreground, repeated in the lower part of the sky

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 贴面朝向观者
content: 把物体紧贴画面平面放置，使其正面方形正对观者，此时该面在透视中与几何图形一致，便于对位与量取。
quote: the cube _C_ is placed close to the transparent picture plane, indeed touches it, and that the square _fj_ faces the spectator _E_

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 楔形构图斜贯画面
content: 把画面宽度分成两个楔形块面，沿斜角横穿全画并向上收进左侧的坡岸与树木；用长地平线和云、叶的圆形形体与之对抗，再用另一侧的岩石块面取得平衡。
quote: The breadth is divided into two wedge-shaped forms, carried at an angle across the work, and up into the bank and trees on the left

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 圆中矩形
content: 把矩形主体置于圆形观察范围内，用圆的包容性收住矩形的硬边，避免画面外散。
quote: Rectangle in Circle

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 黑白人物统摄全画
content: 把穿黑白对比服装的人物放在前景一侧，可聚焦画面其余所有明暗，只要其他明暗强度更弱，就会各归其位。
quote: a figure, clothed in black and white, and placed on one side of the foreground, will focus _all the other_ lights and shadows

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 视点即画面投影
content: 把竖直平面当作玻璃片时，观者眼睛E在画面上的投影就是视点S；由眼到物体的视线穿过画面处的交点，即为该物体的透视位置。
quote: Then if _E_ is the eye of the spectator, its projection on the picture is _S_, the point of sight.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 阴影横贯中景的益处
content: 把阴影横贯主体中部，可强化前景力度、便于处理背景，并让地平线与云融合获得纵深与宁静，人物则在其上切出浮雕感。
quote: Carrying the shadow across the _middle_ of the subject is attended with many advantages

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 用后退线替代消失线
content: 描述向纵深延伸的线时，优先用 retreating lines / going-away lines（fuyante）而非 vanishing line，因为后者暗示线本身消失；消失点同理宜称 point de fuite。术语沿用旧称时也应尽量少用。
quote: a vanishing line implies a line that disappears, and a vanishing point implies a point that gradually goes out of sight.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 动势即重量
content: 无论出于意图还是动作，朝向某方向的运动，等同于在该方向的空间中加了平衡重量。
quote: Motion toward, either in intention or by action, is equivalent to balancing weight in that space of the picture to which the action is directed.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 头部是构图第一吸引点
content: 无论画什么题材，观者的视线总先被人物头部吸引，因此构图时优先安排各头部的相对位置，再处理其余元素。
quote: Whatever the subject of the picture, the eye is always attracted to the heads.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 引导线指向主体
content: 无论金字塔是透视呈现还是画在画面前平面上，引导线都应把视线带入画面深处或引向主体，而非引向画外。
quote: leading lines should carry the eye into the picture or toward the subject

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 拱形空间忌横排头
content: 早期佛罗伦萨画家常用长排水平头部填充拱形空间，与拱形不协调；圆形头光可稍减其贫弱，但作为装饰整体仍不理想。
quote: we have long horizontal rows of heads which seem out of harmony with the arched space they fill.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 曲线表变化与运动
content: 曲线用于表现变化与运动，与垂直线的庄重、水平线的静谧形成对照，需要动感时以曲线主导画面。
quote: The curved line: variety, movement

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 暖暗对冷灰半暗
content: 最深的暗部用暖棕，并把它紧贴远处的冷灰半暗形成冷暖对比；随后把这块暗色延伸到房屋暗部、两侧屋顶，再在右侧重复，用脚手架压到台阶上，并织入占画面约三分之二的冷灰半调中。
quote: the darkest dark being of a warm brown, is brought up, by contrast, against the half dark in the distance, which is of a cold grey

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 汇聚线需有视觉落点
content: 构图中的汇聚线应避免无意义地指向一点；只有当汇聚点上有值得关注的主体（如争抢的手稿、桌上的金袋）时，汇聚线才成立，此时它不仅是可接受的，而且是必需的。若汇聚点无重点，观众视线被误导会产生失望感。
quote: Converging lines are to be avoided, unless there is something of interest to which you wish to direct attention at the point of convergence.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 线条冲动独立于题材
content: 构图中的线条冲动在情感艺术中发挥作用，其效果独立于题材本身，选线时可先于内容确定情绪基调。
quote: The linear impulse in composition therefore plays a part in emotional art independent of the subject itself.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 视线须越过中线
content: 构图中视线应至少一次越过中央分割线：眼睛从兴趣中心移向画布另一侧，若那边有元素接住，平衡即满足；若空无一物，须补一个元素。
quote: In every composition the eye should cross the central division at least once.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 自然轴线的定义
content: 构图中连接两个最显著体量、或最先吸引视线的那条可见或想象中的线，即为自然轴线；若画面只有一个主体，则由背景中的开口或吸引点与主体连成的方向线充当轴线。
quote: the visible or imaginary line which the eye accepts connecting the two most prominent measures or such a line which first arrests the attention

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 水平与垂直双向平衡
content: 构图可同时在水平线和垂直线上取得平衡，即画面不仅左右配重，上下也需配重。
quote: This picture also balances on the horizontal and vertical lines.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 地平线避开画面中线
content: 构图时地平线不要正好把画布等分为上下两半，应明显高于或低于中线；人物画（尤其室内无地平线可见的场景）同样适用，实践中通常把地平线放在中线以下较多。
quote: In every picture, the horizon should be either above or below the centre of the canvas, and not bisect it into two equal portions.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 线条的情绪语义
content: 构图选线时按情绪定方向：垂直线表达庄严、肃穆、静谧；水平线表达安静、休憩、平和；斜线表达速度与动作；曲线表达变化与运动；圆与椭圆表达连续与统一。
quote: Thus pictures conceived in vertical lines bespeak dignity, solemnity, quietude

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 手段不可牺牲目的
content: 果断、自由、熟练的笔法虽有魅力，但不可沉溺其中；表现手段不能取代作品要传达的目的。
quote: The _end_ must not be sacrificed to the means!

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 画框内可切人物
content: 架上或画廊绘画因四周有实体画框，人物被边缘裁切不会让观众不适，可放心让部分人物出画；观众会自动补全画框外的身体。
quote: An easel or gallery picture is bounded on every side by the frame, and the eye is not shocked at all by seeing portions of the figures cut off.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 镜像检查画面
content: 检查画面时可用镜子看其镜像，并闭上一只眼——双眼同时看会使对象周围显得过于拥挤。
quote: keep one eye shut: seeing from both eyes surround the objects too much.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 前景弱化次要元素
content: 次要元素即使位于贴近的前景，也可通过弱化处理（降低其吸引力）使其不干扰主体平衡，而不必删除。
quote: the head of the dog is so treated that it attracts but little, though the object be in the close foreground.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 等边三角形透视失真
content: 正对我们的等边三角形侧面，因顶部比底边远（如远382英尺），透视中不会呈现为等边三角形，画时应按远近压缩顶角。
quote: the side of the pyramid that faces us, although an equilateral triangle, does not appear so, as its top angle is 382 feet farther off than its base

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 先找出画面的叛逆元素
content: 每幅画都存在一个始终不驯服的元素，需反复调整其位置与处理方式，直到它与其他部分协调为止，不要指望一次摆位就解决。
quote: There is always a rebellious member in every picture, which continues unruly throughout its whole construction

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 垂直与水平的交叉
content: 水平线与垂直线交叉时，用点状元素（spot）做转移，避免交叉点成为死结或分散注意。
quote: Crossings of Horizontals by Spot Diversion

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 垂线求第三角
content: 求底面第三角的位置时，从已定的对应点向下作垂线，与通向视点的斜线相交，交点即为该角在透视中的位置。
quote: The position of the third corner of the base is found by dropping a perpendicular from _K_, till it meets the line _eS_.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 量点由等腰三角形求得
content: 求某条消失线的量点时，以灭点连线一端为圆心、该段长度为半径画弧交基线，连接交点与另一端，延长交地平线所得交点即为该消失线的量点。
quote: Continue line _m'b_ till it cuts the horizon in _m_, which point will be the measuring point for the vanishing line _AbV_.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 轴线平衡的统一效果
content: 沿轴线构建平衡，可获得与在中央垂直线上使用杆秤同样统一的结果，是达成画面统一的有效手段。
quote: Balance constructed over this line will bring the worker to as unified a result as the use of the steelyard on the central vertical line.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 基线量宽
content: 物体宽度在基线（地平线）上量取：先在地面线定出底边宽度（如 ef），再据此立起立体，如立方体 C 立于方形 efgh 之上。
quote: Another important line is _AB_, the +Base+ or +Ground line+, as it is on this that we measure the width of any object to be represented

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 平衡物不可造成兴趣分裂
content: 用于平衡的小配重（如秤砣式元素）不能变成第二个视觉焦点，否则会分散观众注意力、破坏主次。
quote: the small balancing weight of the steelyard should not become a point causing divided interest.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 同心线汇聚顶点
content: 用从画面下角向金字塔顶点汇聚的同心线组织画面，可避免构图落入常见而平庸的样式。
quote: the very frequent use of these concentric lines drawing the vision from the lower corners of the picture to an apex of the pyramid

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 侧视图读纵深
content: 用侧视图（画面平面以侧边线表示）检查纵深关系：可读出眼睛位于视点 S 前方，以及水平线与基线向远处退去的方向。
quote: This is a side view of the previous figure, the picture plane _K_ being represented edgeways, and the line _SE_ its full length.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 同类同色削弱主体
content: 用同类、同色的物体把某对象包围起来，可降低它在画面中的重要性。
quote: An object may be rendered less important by surrounding it with objects of its own kind and color.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 明暗量对立与过渡
content: 用明暗块面的对立制造张力，再以过渡（transition）缓和；对立加过渡比纯对立更耐看。
quote: Oppposition of Light and Dark Measures

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 白色由路引至天空
content: 用白色做贯穿元素：从白垩路开始，接到树干、岩石，再借飞鸟把白点带上云层，让最亮色沿一条路径从前景走到天空。
quote: the white of the chalky road is carried into their trunks, the rock, and up into the clouds by the birds

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 过渡线引导视线
content: 用过渡线（transitional line）连接画面中的主要元素，使视线沿其自然移动，避免元素孤立。
quote: Transitional line

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 黏土模型预演群像
content: 画多人物场景前，可先做整体设计的小黏土模型，用不同明度的湿布片裹住小人；布片蘸泥水干后变硬，可移动人物而不破坏衣褶安排。
quote: make a small clay model of the whole design, and to clothe their little figures with rags of different shades

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 平行透视正方形
content: 画正方形时令两边平行于画面、另两边垂直于画面，即平行透视；先定基线点，再向视点连线求纵深边。
quote: a square with two of its sides parallel to the picture plane and the other two at right angles to it

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 用面替代物
content: 画面上的实体对象可用该处明暗变化的面来替代，暗面或亮面的变化能取得与实体对象同等的吸引力。
quote: An object upon a surface may frequently give place to a dark or light variation of the surface itself which becomes an equivalent of attraction.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 中央亮块与反向
content: 画面中央一大块亮部被阴影包围是一条基本规则；将其反转（中央暗块被亮部包围）同样具有强烈的视觉冲击力。
quote: A large mass of light in the middle of the picture, surrounded by shadow, is a rule; and, when reversed, has an equally imposing effect.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 单元吸引力随位置变化
content: 画面中每个单元都有一定价值，其价值取决于吸引力，而吸引力随该单元在画面中的位置而变化。
keywords: 单元吸引力随位置变化
quote: The value of a unit depends on its attraction; its attraction varies as to its placement.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 整体效果优先于局部
content: 画面中每个局部（人物、服饰）单独看可以很精致，但若各局部彼此孤立、缺少统摄，整幅画就会像拼贴的小照片集；构图时应先确定整体效果，再让细节服从它。
quote: Each individual figure or gaudy bit of stuff is perfect by itself, but the whole picture is deficient in effect.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 空白空间的吸引力
content: 画面中留白区域若缺乏细节，可通过渐变（gradation）与联想（association）来制造吸引力，避免大片死白。
quote: Space having no detail may possess attraction by gradation and by association.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 亮部揭示构图形式
content: 画面中的亮斑或高光常用来解释整体构图的形式，可据此安排光位以点明结构。
quote: The luminous spots or lights in a picture, frequently explain the _form_ of its composition.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 明暗与人物成块成组
content: 画面中的亮部、暗部与人物都应归并为大块面与成组分布，彼此有变化与对比，不要散成等量小点。
quote: Objects, whether they consist of lights, shadows, or figures, must be disposed in large _masses_ and groups, properly varied and contrasted

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 三种画面平衡法
content: 画面平衡有三种思路：不等量平衡（杆秤式）、沿自然轴两侧平衡、孤立量之间的平衡；按主体分布选择对应平衡方式。
quote: Three Ideas in Pictorial Balance

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 画面空间皆有吸引力
content: 画面空间的每一部分都带有一定吸引力，因此留白区域本身也有视觉重量，不可当作无物。
quote: Every part of the picture space has some attraction.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 黑白对比强于灰底
content: 白底上的黑单元或黑底上的白单元，比同样单元放在灰底上吸引力更强；要突出主体就用高对比底色，要弱化就用灰底。
quote: A black unit on white or a white on black has more attraction than the same on gray.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 平衡需兼顾纵深与横向
content: 秤砣式平衡原则不仅适用于画面横向，也适用于纵深方向，布置元素时要在前后深度上同样配平。
keywords: 平衡需兼顾纵深与横向
quote: the principle of the steelyards covers the items in the depth as well as across the breadth of the picture.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 凸形轮廓造庄严
content: 米开朗基罗笔下女巫与先知的庄严尊贵，更多来自饱满的凸形轮廓，而非其巨大比例。
quote: There is a majestic dignity about them which is due rather to their full convex outlines than to their colossal proportions.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 红色收束于视觉焦点
content: 红色只用在树干与枝条上，并全部汇聚到右侧人物身上作为终点，使红色成为引导视线走向主体的线索色，而不是平均铺开。
quote: the reds are gathered up in the branches and stems of the trees, and brought to a point in the figure on the right

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 单眼视点与画面位置
content: 线性透视的前提是单眼观察：所有视线从单一视点发出，而非双眼；视点须固定在地面上方某一高度、并与画面保持固定距离，画面本身竖直且垂直于水平地面。
quote: we are supposed to look at objects with one eye only; that is, the visual rays are drawn from a single point, and not from two.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 折线的吸引力
content: 线条方向的突然转折，其吸引力可等同于该线上放置一个实体对象。
quote: An abrupt change in the direction of a line may have attraction equal to an object on that line.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 船与月的构图条件
content: 船与月可作竖幅构图；若改为长幅，则必须补上指示船行方向的引导线，或在另一半（远景或前景）加吸引物，且前景所需分量远少于远景。
quote: The _ship and moon_ compose as an upright, but not in long shape without either the following line which indicates the ship’s course

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 亮块边缘要硬
content: 若一块亮部或发光体四周被暗背景包围，它至少应有一条边缘是强烈、锐利的；否则亮块会失去轮廓。
quote: If a single light or luminous mass be surrounded on all sides by a dark ground, one or more of its edges should be strong and cutting

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 冷灰底的暖色呼应
content: 若地面为冷灰（如河景），船可画成黄色、人物画成红色，并把暖色向上扩散到天空的暖光，或落在沙岸、远处建筑乃至空中飞鸟上，使颜色贯穿全画。
quote: if the ground be cool grey, as in a river scene, the boats may be yellow, and the figures red, carried up and diffused into the warm lights of the sky

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 全臂可见优于局部露臂
content: 若必须画举臂，让举臂人物的全身可见（如拉斐尔凉廊中的处理）效果虽平淡琐碎，但不至于滑稽；而当手臂从不露全身的背景人物中零星冒出时，则很难避免可笑的效果。
quote: When, however, an arm crops up here and there from the unseen figures of the background, it is difficult to avoid the ludicrous.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 题材选择影响格调
content: 若题材本身轻浮、炫示，即使技法精妙也难成佳作；选材时应避开纯粹卖弄的题材，优先能承载整体效果与格调的内容。
quote: the subjects he affected were of the most frivolous and meretricious description

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 荷兰海岸画的云空比例
content: 荷兰风景画家普遍采用该布局：保留约三分之二的画面给云的发亮形体，以取得力度与柔和的对比，常见于海岸场景。
quote: leaving so large a space as two-thirds of the picture for the luminous forms of the clouds.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 用分离讲清叙事
content: 表现刺杀类场面时，可把凶手群像与被害者明确分开、凶手不再理会尸体，仅凭位置关系就能让不知情的观者读懂事件。
quote: The group of assassins are quite separated from their victim, and are giving themselves no further trouble about him

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 斜线用于动作与速度
content: 表现动作与速度时采用斜线构图，如《燕子》一图所示。
quote: The diagonal: line of action; speed

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 水平线用于静谧场面
content: 表现安静、休憩、平静、肃穆的场面时，采用水平线为主的构图。
quote: The horizontal, typifying quietude, repose, calm, solemnity

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 高视平线削弱体量感
content: 表现巨大物体（如金字塔）时，视平线越高，观者越接近俯视，物体的体量压迫感越弱；要强调宏伟高大，应压低视平线，让物体高过画面中心。
quote: I have taken a much higher horizon, which immediately detracts from the impression of the bigness of the pyramid.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 垂直线用于庄重场面
content: 表现庄重、有节律、厚重的场面时，采用垂直线为主的构图，如柱、直干树、上升烟等垂直形态。
quote: Vertical line in action; dignified, measured, ponderous

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 地平线置于画外
content: 表现被缚、压抑等特殊题材时，可把地平线完全放到画面下方（如画面底部只见山峰，真实地平线远在其下）；必要时也可放到画面上方，例外题材须例外处理。
quote: In a “Prometheus Bound” you might with great propriety place your horizon below the picture altogether.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 椭圆线用于统一连续
content: 表现连续与统一的旋转感时，采用椭圆线构图，如鲁本斯《舞蹈》。
quote: The ellipse: line of continuity and unity

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 壁画不可切人物
content: 装饰画或壁画没有实体画框把画面与墙面隔开，仅有装饰边或线脚不足以支撑裁切人物，因此不应照搬架上画的出画处理。
quote: but in decorative or mural painting there is no solid framework round the picture isolating it from the surrounding wall.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 用对角线求中心
content: 要在透视中确定方形或立体的中心位置，连接对角线，其交点即为透视中心，可据此把高度中心对准底面中心。
quote: find its centre _O'_ by means of diagonals, and _O'_ will be the central height of the pyramid

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 等分线段的几何作图法
content: 要把给定直线AB分成五等份：从A任取角度画辅助线AC，用圆规在其上量出五等份，连接5C与5B，再从AC上各分点作平行于5-5的线交AB，即得等分点。
quote: Draw _AC_ at any convenient angle, and measure off five equal parts with the compasses thereon, as 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. From 5C draw line to 5B.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 前景物体轮廓要切割
content: 要突出的物体，其轮廓应从周围阴影中锐利、强烈地切出；其余块面则按密度对比的减弱程度依次后退。
quote: The outline of an object we would bring most forward should come out _cutting_ and strong from its surrounding shadow

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 线条汇入椭圆
content: 要表现优雅，让线条或多或少汇入椭圆弧线，保持自由、不做作；过度修饰会从优雅滑向矫饰。
quote: Grace, in my opinion, consists of lines flowing, more or less, into the ellipsis--free of constraint and affectation.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 背景决定主体分离
content: 要让圆形或立体主体从背景中脱离，靠的是背景与主体在颜色或明度上的差异；差异越大，主体越突出。
quote: Different colours, or degrees of light in the background, can alone separate the object from it.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 明暗交界处的融合
content: 要让画面获得整体感（breadth），把人物亮部与背景亮部融合处理，暗部同理与背景暗部融合，避免主体与背景在明暗上硬性割裂。
quote: Breadth is acquired by blending the light parts of the figures with the light of the ground; and the same rule will apply to the shadows.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 视点即观者眼位
content: 视点（Station-point）画在透视图中，代表观者眼睛的位置；机位设定即确定该点在画面中的落位。
quote: _E_ is the position of the eye of the spectator, being drawn in perspective, and is called the +Station-point+.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 视点偏向光源一侧
content: 视点（平行透视中即灭点）不要放在画面正中，除非题材极为严正；应把它放在靠近光源来向的那一侧。
quote: It should be nearest to that side of the picture from which the light comes.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 几何图与透视图对照
content: 讲解透视时，把同一形状的几何视图与透视图并排摆放（如正方形、平行线、垂线、等长线、圆），便于对照理解两者差异。
quote: I will here make a note of them and also place side by side the two views of the same figures.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 轴线贯穿画面
content: 轴线不只是连接画面内两点，而是贯穿画面；轴线靠近观众的一端对平衡起重要作用，构图时须考虑该近端的位置与分量。
quote: The axis does not merely connect two points within the picture, but pierces it, and the near end of the shaft has much to do with this balance.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 轴线明确时优先采用
content: 轴线法约束较少；当轴线在画面中标记清晰时应优先采用，但并非每个题材都能发展出轴线，需先判断题材是否具备。
quote: In this method there is less restraint and when the axis is well marked it is best to take it. Not every subject develops it however.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 垂直破坏画面统一
content: 过多垂直线会破坏画面的统一感；需要统一时减少垂直线，改用水平或曲线主导。
quote: Verticals Destroying Pictorial Unity

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 透视作图须高精度
content: 透视分割与量点作图对精度要求很高，线条交点稍有偏差就会导致比例失真，因此绘制时须格外准确。
quote: Of course great accuracy is necessary.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 抑制边角成圆
content: 通过压暗或弱化四边与四角，把方形画幅的视线收成圆形观察，突出中心。
quote: Circular Observation by Suppression of Sides and Corners

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 大气密度做明暗渐变
content: 通过大气密度（如雾、云影）对光做渐变，使远近层次自然分离，而非靠轮廓线区分。
quote: Light Graded by Atmospheric Density

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 用视点连线量取进深
content: 量取远处物体在画面中的实际长度时，从物体两端向视点（心点）连线，与基线相交所得线段即为该距离处的透视长度，再按比例累加。
quote: By drawing _AS_ and _BS_ to point of sight we find _Te_, which measures 100 feet at a distance of 1,600 feet.

source_ref.title: The Theory and Practice of Perspective
source_ref.author: G. A. Storey

title: 金字塔构图不可通用
content: 金字塔式构图不应被当作万能法则套用；它只适合静态庄严题材，对动作场面或横向长幅画面明显不合适。
quote: Now it is clearly unsuitable for subjects of action, or for filling with figures low long panels

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 优雅线的序列
content: 需要优雅、变化、流畅序列时，采用优雅线构图，如《冬日风景》所示。
quote: Line of grace, variety, facile sequence

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 曲线用于变化与凝聚
content: 需要变化与运动感时用曲线；需要过渡与凝聚感时用过渡线，如《持石者》所示。
quote: The curved line: variety, movement; Man with Stone--V. Spitzer (Transitional Line, Cohesion)

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 放射线强化焦点
content: 需要强烈聚焦时采用放射线构图，使线条汇聚于焦点，如《十二月》所示。
quote: Radial lines with strong focalization

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 以吸引点移物
content: 需要把画面中某物（树、人物等）从原位移开时，不必涂掉重画，而在它将被移向的那一侧制造吸引点（开天光、加色彩或形体吸引），视线被引到该物另一侧，原物即被挤出原有平衡位置。
quote: the result is attained by creating an attraction on the side from which it is to be moved.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 中性背景最显立体
content: 需要最大程度凸显主体时，用中性或不确定色的背景；此时主体的立体感完全依赖其自身明暗关系。
quote: The greatest relief is acquired by a ground of a _neutral_, or undetermined colour.

source_ref.title: The Use of a Box of Colours, in a Practical Demonstration on Composition
source_ref.author: Harry Willson

title: 题材越戏剧越可破格
content: 题材越如画、越情节剧化，越可以偏离常规构图规则；平淡题材则应更守规则。
quote: The more picturesque or melodramatic the subject, the more he may depart from the usual rules of composition.

source_ref.title: Lectures on Painting, Delivered to the Students of the Royal Academy
source_ref.author: Edward Armitage

title: 风景金字塔侧卧
content: 风景构图中金字塔应侧卧，顶点向画面深处后退，而非正立，以形成纵深。
quote: In the landscape the pyramid lies on its side, the apex receding.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: 对比面积决定重量
content: 黑或白单元的视觉价值与其所对比的空间面积成正比：对比面积越大，该单元越重。
quote: The value of a black or white unit is proportioned to the size of space contrasting with it.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Composition and the Critical Judgment of Pictures
source_ref.author: Henry Rankin Poore

title: NOTAN与光影的区别
content: NOTAN是画面内部明暗色块的量比与配置，属于普遍美感元素；LIGHT AND SHADOW是外部自然的单一事实。构图时按notan组织画面明暗块面，而非照搬自然光影。
quote: Careful distinction should be made between NOTAN, an element of universal beauty, and LIGHT AND SHADOW, a single fact of external nature.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 明暗之美来自块面组合
content: notan之美来自明暗块面的组合和谐，不论是否着色、不论用于建筑、绘画还是自然景物，都按同一标准衡量。
quote: Notan‐beauty means the harmony resulting from the combination of dark and light spaces—whether colored or not

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 教学推进顺序
content: 一般教学顺序为：先分别练习线、notan、色彩各要素，再回头分别做更细致的研究，然后合并，逐步走向高级构图；无论选择何种顺序，都必须先扎实掌握空间切割与简单明暗块面的基本关系。
quote: the best plan is to take up exercises in each element in turn; then go back to them separately and make more detailed studies; then combine them

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 想象线也能构成画面
content: 两个主体之间即使没有可见线条，只要位置关系明确，那条想象连线在画面中与可见线条同样有力，可用来连接主体、形成戏剧统一。
quote: only an imaginary line between the faces of the man and the boy, but that imaginary line is nevertheless as vivid as any visible thing

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 文字排版归入线条明暗
content: 书籍、海报、手稿中的文字排版应视为线条与明暗（notan of line）的构图问题，首要考虑的是字块之间的间距安排。
quote: lettering should be classed as Notan of Line. Obviously the spacing of masses of letters has first consideration

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 少线也能成大关系
content: 仅用几条直线，通过运动与间距的和谐安排，即可构成高级构图；帕特农神庙与乔托钟楼的比例都可简化为几条关系精妙的直线。
quote: the proportions of the Parthenon and Giotto’s Tower can be reduced to a few straight lines finely related and spaced

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 站点线垂直定位
content: 从视点S向纸面底部作一条垂直线SR，称为站点线，用于确定观者站位与画面的垂直对应关系。
quote: From _S_ let fall a perpendicular line, _SR_, to the bottom of the paper, and call this line the “Station-Line.”

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 长线作为构图母题
content: 以一条长线作为画面基本母题：这里的“线”不限于单笔，而是由线条、形状甚至斑点连续排列成的一条供眼睛追随的轨迹。
quote: any succession of lines, shapes, or even spots, so arranged that they make a track for the eye to follow

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 消失点必在视线线上
content: 任何平面内所有直线的消失点都落在该平面的 sight-line 上；反之，连接同一平面内任意两个消失点即可求出该平面的 sight-line。
quote: all vanishing-points of lines in any plane must be found on its sight-line

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 斜面的视线边界
content: 任何平面向远处延伸，在观察者眼中都会终止于一条边界线：水平面为水平线（近似可见地平线），垂直面为垂直线，斜面为斜线；这条线称为该平面的 sight-line，只有水平面才可称 horizon。
quote: it will be terminated, to the eye of the observer, by a boundary line, which, in a horizontal plane, is horizontal

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 锐点出纯线
content: 使用尖锐笔尖作画时产生的是纯线条，其品质可以做到极高；惠斯勒的蚀刻版画即追求线条美，阴影与调子只被感受而不被表现。
quote: If a sharp point is used in drawing, it will produce pure line, whose quality may reach any degree of excellence.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 书籍页面的构图练习
content: 做书籍页面构图练习时，用一块浅灰明度代表文字块的位置与重量，自由运笔，不必拘泥于色阶与间隔的精确计算，需要更细腻效果处加入渐变。
quote: Compose for a book‐page, using one light gray value to represent the effect of type

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 明暗双值练习法
content: 做明暗（notan）构图训练时，先用两值（黑/白）在既有线稿上反复套用不同明暗方案，重点不是复制原图，而是借旧图案生成新的明暗关系。
quote: copy or trace the line and play upon this several notan‐schemes of two values.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 多方案并排择优
content: 做构图练习时先大量尝试不同排布方案，把它们并排摆开，再从中挑出最好的一个。
quote: Try a large number of arrangements, set them up in a row and pick out the best.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 方形圆形内部分割练习
content: 做构图练习时选边界确定、规则的封闭形（方形与圆形最佳，因外框不可变），用等粗线条把内部切成和谐的小区域组，注意力集中在内部线条的分割上。
quote: Choose an enclosed area of definite and regular shape, and break it up into a harmonious group of smaller areas by drawing lines.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 丑的负担在脑不在眼
content: 判断画面丑不丑，不看眼球运动是否费力（优雅线与锯齿线的眼动几乎相同），而看大脑辨识是否费力；因此构图取舍以'是否易于被心智快速把握'为准，而非以线条是否平滑的物理属性为准。
quote: the difference must lie in that function of seeing which the brain performs

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 丑线条靠重复成组
content: 单看不好看的线条，若与对称位置的相似线条成组出现，会因平衡或重复而变得悦目；因此成组（EF、FG、EFG）比单独一条更可取。
quote: lines which are ugly when considered singly take on a kind of beauty or interestingness when considered as a group

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 线群自然生调子
content: 即便主张针笔只画线，线条聚集处也必然产生调子并暗示块面（线的notan）；蚀刻版画在印刷擦版过程中还会把这种效果发展为丰富的渐变。
quote: clustering of lines inevitably produces tone and suggests massing

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 水面倒影画成垂直线
content: 发光点或孤立物体（如日、月）在水中的倒影，在透视中应画成一条垂直线，因为该倒影延长后会从观者脚下穿过。
quote: The reflection in water of any luminous point or isolated object (such as the sun or moon) is therefore, in perspective, a vertical line

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 禅意与哥特避用对称
content: 受禅宗哲学影响的日本艺术视对称为无趣而刻意回避；哥特艺术出自富创造力的想象，也从不以平庸方式使用对称。追求趣味或想象力的画面应避免常规对称。
quote: Japanese art, when influenced by Zen philosophy, as Okakura Kakuzo tells us in “The Book of Tea”, avoids symmetry as uninteresting.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 直线设计的明暗手段
content: 受限于只用直线的设计（如纺织品图案），可通过加粗线条、变化色调深浅、施以色彩来扩展表现范围，说明窄题材也能有宽表现。
quote: They widen lines, vary their depth of tone, glorify them with color, and show that what seems a narrow field is really one of wide range.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 运动中的静止感
content: 在充满运动与破坏的场景中，通过均衡的构图安排，可以让画面传达出瞬间的静止与安宁感。
quote: because of the artistic composition of the picture, we get from it all a momentary sense of repose, as though war itself were at rest.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 坡度随方向变化
content: 在斜面上，越靠近最陡线 CD 的线越陡，越靠近水平线 AB 的线越接近水平；绘制坡面纹理或分层时应按此渐变处理线的倾斜。
quote: The nearer the lines to _CD_, the steeper they will be; and the nearer to _AB_, the more nearly horizontal.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 地毯构图两原则
content: 处理地毯类构图时，把它视为从属（Subordination）与重复（Repetition）两原则的组合：主体与边框要有主次，母题要重复出现。
quote: As composition it is a combination of two principles: Subordination and Repetition.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 线条组合的和谐取舍
content: 多条线并置时，选各自都优雅的线（A+B）组合，比优雅线与丑线混搭（B+C）或双丑线（C+D）更悦目；判断标准是组合后能否被快速把握为一个统一整体。
quote: lines A and B taken together make a more pleasing combination than lines B and C or lines C and D

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 线条汇聚点做主体位
content: 多条线相交的汇聚点是视线天然落点，把主体放在线条汇聚处（如树根处）能获得更强强调；若主体远离汇聚点，强调会被削弱。
quote: this picture would have given more emphasis to the woman if she had been placed near the root of the tree trunk, where many lines converge

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 临摹优质原作
content: 学习构图应直接面对原作、照片复制品、描摹稿或石膏模；粗劣的石版画与木刻插图无法传达原作，不可用作参考。
quote: The commonplace lithographic plates and rude wood cuts in some books of design are useless for our purpose.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 对称易流于廉价设计
content: 对称因构造需要（人体、船只、建筑、家具、陶器、书籍）或模仿而被滥用，一旦不讲究形体之美，就会落入廉价平庸的设计；使用对称时须以形体美感为前提，不可机械套用。
quote: Symmetry, like Repetition, has come to be used in cheap and mean design where no regard is paid to beauty of form.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 斜平面最陡线消失点
content: 已知斜平面视平线VX时，延长其与水平视平线交于X；连TX并作TY垂直于TX得直角消失点Y；由Y作垂线YP交斜平面视平线于P，P即该平面内最陡线的消失点，所有指向P的线为平面内最陡线。
quote: Then _P_ is the vanishing-point of steepest lines in the plane.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 幼龄学员从色彩入手
content: 年龄很小的学员应从色彩开始，但教师须在每节课中纳入间距（spacing）与notan的练习，避免只练色彩而缺失结构基础。
quote: Very young pupils should begin with color but the instructor will take pains to include spacing and notan in each lesson.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 临摹大师线描
content: 手部控制与线条质感可通过临摹日本笔绘与大师线描（如曾我萧白、伦勃朗、达芬奇）来训练，临摹安排在基础练习之后。
quote: Copy brush drawings from Japanese books, for a study of control of the hand and quality of touch

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 构图优先于再现
content: 把构图置于再现之上：先学艺术本身（构图），透视、解剖、颜料与工具等再现技能会在需要时自然习得，它们是辅助而非替代。
quote: they are only helps to art, not substitutes for it

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 抽象设计与画面同构
content: 把画面与抽象设计视为结构上高度相似，可用简单间隔（spacing）的练习来理解风景构图。
quote: the picture and the abstract design are much alike in structure, let us see how some of the simple spacings may be illustrated by landscape.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 画面本质是线条图案
content: 把画面在起始阶段当作线条图案来处理，先确定线条的分布与分割，再进入明暗与色彩阶段。
quote: A picture, then, may be said to be in its beginning actually a pattern of lines.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 前后景之间设平衡点
content: 把背景与前景作为两组力量对比时，在两者之间（如街道最窄处）设一个平衡点，使视线从前到后或从后到前的扫视连续均匀，不偏向任何一侧。
quote: if we take the background of the picture as against the foreground, we shall find a balancing point in the narrowest part of the street.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 徒手画线忌机械工具
content: 描线时避免僵硬紧绷的线条和一切尺规痕迹或刻意费力的感觉；不使用任何量具，尺寸、形状与方向都必须不借助机械辅助来决定。
quote: Avoid hard wiry lines and all that savors of rule and compass or laborious pains‐taking. Use no measure of any kind

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 首帧即见中心兴趣
content: 放映的第一瞬间观众就应看到画面的中心兴趣；因此开拍前就要摆好所有指示线、手势、衣褶等引导元素，并让这些线与先前运动物体的路径衔接，使视线立刻扫向中心兴趣。
quote: The spectator in the theater should be enabled to see the central interest at the very first instant of projection.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 数量平衡与对称
content: 数量平衡指画面左右两半或上下两半的物象数量对比；它常与基本图形的对称相关，例如三角形构图。
quote: Balance of quantity is often connected with symmetry in the fundamental pattern, as in the figure of the triangle.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 整体即美与噪音之别
content: 整体性是美的必要条件，它把音乐与噪音区分开来；构图时任何局部都不能压过整体。
quote: In a word, wholeness is essential to beauty; it distinguishes Music from Noise.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 斜平面水平线消失点
content: 斜平面视平线与水平视平线的交点X，就是该斜平面内所有水平线的消失点；画斜面上的水平线时统一指向X。
quote: _X_ is the vanishing-point of all horizontal lines in the inclined plane.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 线、明暗与色彩的关系
content: 构图三要素为线（LINE）、明暗块面（NOTAN）与色彩（COLOR）：线指形状边界与线面关系，notan指明暗色块的量比与分布，色彩指光的品质。好色彩依赖好notan，好notan依赖好间距，因此设计顺序应先线、再notan、后色彩。
quote: Good color is dependent upon good notan, and that in turn is dependent upon good spacing.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 亮部优先吸引视线
content: 构图中若想让观众先看到某主体，可让该主体成为画面中最亮的区域（如暗背景上的一块白），因为眼睛天然先寻光后寻暗；反之若主体处于暗部而别处有亮斑，注意力会被亮斑抢走。
quote: a patch of white on an area of dark will attract the eye, because it is natural for the eye to seek light in preference to dark

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 和谐即美的关系
content: 构图的核心是创造线条、块面与色彩之间的良好关系（和谐、美），一切造型训练都应围绕感知与创造这种关系展开。
quote: Art study is the attempt to perceive and to create fine relations of line, mass and color.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 记忆度检验构图优劣
content: 检验一个构图是否成功，可用记忆测试：合上画面后能否凭记忆复现其线条；优雅线条几乎可完整记住，丑线条连局部都记不住，说明前者观看更成功，而成功的观看更令人愉悦。
quote: you remember A and B almost perfectly, while you can hardly remember a single part of either C or D

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 倒置画面检验构图
content: 检验构图是否平衡时，把画面倒过来看，可更清楚地看出线条与重量的分布关系。
quote: This relation can be clearly seen by holding the “still” upside down.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 水平线的灭点求法
content: 求一条给定水平线的灭点时，从视点T作一条与该水平线平行的直线，它与视平线（sight-line）的交点V即为该线的灭点。
quote: From _T_, the station-point, draw _TV_ parallel to _AB_, cutting the sight-line in _V_. _V_ is the Vanishing-point required.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 斜平面视平线求法
content: 求倾斜平面的视平线：先分别求出平面内两条线的消失点V与V′，连接VV′并延长与视平线相交于X，VX即为该斜平面的视平线；它可向两端无限延长，平面向下延伸时会与水平视平线相交。
quote: Join _VV′_ and produce it to cut the sight-line in _X_. Then _VX_ is the sight-line of the inclined plane.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 斜面法线消失点求法
content: 求垂直于斜平面表面的线（法线）的消失点：取平面内一条最陡线AB及其相对水平线的消失点V，过V作垂线GF；由A在相对水平线上取AC，在垂直平面内以AC为直径作半圆ADC交AB于E，据此确定法线消失点。
quote: Through _V_ draw the vertical _GF_ upwards and downwards.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 测线的定义与画法
content: 测线是过线段起点、用于量取视大小的水平线；若线段位于视平线之上，测线也画在上方，分割点连线则向下引向分割点。
quote: The horizontal line drawn through _a_, on which the sight-magnitudes are measured, is called the “MEASURING-LINE.”

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 对称构图的两分平衡
content: 满足秩序感最直接的做法是把两条等长的线或两个等大的形做精确对等平衡，如人字屋顶、门两侧的窗、架上并列的器物；对称适用于三、四部分或偶数平衡的组群，但最典型的是两部分对等排列。
quote: The most common and obvious way of satisfying the desire for order is to place two equal lines or shapes in exact balance

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 灭点连线平行于原线
content: 灭点V与视点T的连线TV，在空间上平行于产生该灭点的原直线AB；可据此校验灭点位置是否正确。
quote: Join _TV_. Then the student will find experimentally that _TV_ is parallel to _AB_.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 主曲线定调全画
content: 用一条主导曲线（如人物背部的弧线）配合一条平衡线（如器皿侧边），即可为整幅画面的布局定下基调，使观众一眼把握全局。
quote: you will observe instantly the beautifully curving line of the woman’s back and also a balancing line down the side of the urn

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 对比平衡
content: 用对立元素互相平衡，如明对暗、直线对曲线，在画面中成对布置。
quote: And there is the balance of contrasts, such as light against shadow, or straight lines against curved lines.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 椭圆构图的视线路径
content: 用椭圆或环形线条组织画面时，让线条成为眼睛的顺畅路径，把主体（如两人）绑进同一戏剧单元；椭圆可见部分的断口可放在主体面部处，使视线每次绕行时都被短暂钉在面部。
quote: The lines furnish easy paths for the eye, and bind the boy and man together into a dramatic unity.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 呼应母题平衡
content: 用重复出现的母题来平衡画面，即满足观众眼睛对呼应元素的预期。
quote: Another kind of balance is that of echoing motifs, a sort of fulfillment of the eye’s expectations.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 一笔成线的练习法
content: 画加粗线条时要求一笔完成：先把笔尖压到所需宽度，再匀速拉出线条，以此训练笔触控制。
quote: Push the point of the brush down to the required width, then draw the line.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 执笔垂直全臂运笔
content: 画线时笔杆保持垂直于纸面，以便向任意方向自由移动；运笔用整只手和手臂一次扫出，不要只用手指，必要时以手腕或小指末端抵纸稳定。
quote: For line drawing the brush is held in a perpendicular position, that it may move freely in all directions

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 慢画以意志控线
content: 画线要非常慢，让线条在笔尖下生长时能被观察和引导；表现力来自意志对手的控制而非惯性冲力，轻微抖动反而常给线条增添性格。
quote: Draw very slowly. Expressive line is not made by mere momentum, but by force of will controlling the hand.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 斜线用矩形对角线定位
content: 画透视中的斜线时，把它当作一个矩形的对角线来处理：先确定矩形的水平边AC的位置与长度，再确定竖直边AD的高度，斜线AB的斜率与位置即被唯一确定。
keywords: 斜线用矩形对角线定位
quote: the position of an inclined line may be most conveniently defined by considering it as the diagonal of a rectangle

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 长线用长笔短线用短笔
content: 画长而连续的线条时选长锋毛笔，画尖锐转角或断续线时选短锋毛笔；写字则把长锋笔尖剪平使用。
quote: Long brushes are best for long continuous lines, short brushes for sharp corners and broken lines.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 长线牵引视线
content: 画面中最长的线条会先被眼睛捕捉并顺着它移动；可用长线（如倒下的树干、栏杆）把观众视线引向戏剧主体，也可检查长线是否把视线引到了非重点处。
quote: It is also natural for the eye to catch and follow the longest line in a composition.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 引导线须指向戏剧焦点
content: 画面中的直线（如床铺、桌子的边线）应朝向戏剧焦点汇聚，以提供统一与力度；若某组线条（如窗框）自成孤立图案、把视线引离焦点，整体设计即不完整，观看会不顺畅。
quote: the lines of the window make an isolated pattern which, instead of leading one’s eye toward the dramatic focus, does just the opposite.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 失衡的两种成因
content: 画面失衡常因某一半同时承载过多戏剧兴趣与过多物体、形状、线条；判断时先看兴趣分布再看元素密度。
quote: Besides containing by far the greater dramatic interest, it contains too many objects, shapes, and lines to attract the eye.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 冷暖色平衡
content: 画面除线条构图外，还需考虑冷暖色的平衡，把色彩平衡作为与线条并列的构图课题。
quote: this canvas, as the title indicates, is also a study in the balancing of cool and warm colors

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 风景先作图案
content: 画风景明暗构图时，先把它当图案处理，再当画面处理；其不规则间距与图案的对称性形成对比，套上明暗后效果新奇。
quote: Landscape is a good subject for notan‐composition, to be treated at first as a design, afterward as a picture.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 墨色浓黑靠少水
content: 研墨时只用几滴水即可立刻获得浓黑墨色；墨条用后擦干包纸，绝不可泡在水里。
quote: Intense blackness can be secured immediately by using only a few drops of water.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 向优秀插画师学色调布局
content: 研究优秀插画师的作品时，重点分析其色调方案（tone-scheme）与元素在页面上的位置安排，而非只临摹造型。
quote: Study the work of the best illustrators, noting the tone‐scheme and the placing upon the page.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 斜面用两线定位
content: 确定一个斜面的空间位置，只需在面内取两条线：一条水平线 AB 与一条与之垂直的最陡线 CD；面内平行 AB 的线皆水平，平行 CD 的线皆最陡。
quote: To fix the position of an inclined plane, therefore, is to determine the direction of any two lines in the plane, _AB_ and _CD_

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 练习勿脱离设计
content: 纯技术练习不应占用过多时间，须与构图设计结合，避免为练而练。
quote: too much time should not be given to mere practice, apart from design

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 纵深平衡
content: 纵深平衡指前景的重量与背景的重量相互抵消，安排画面时让前景元素与背景元素在视觉重量上对等。
quote: Further, there is balance through depth, the foreground weighing against the background.

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 线之美的定义
content: 线之美指组合线条的和谐，或由特殊处理赋予的独特品质；判断线条好坏看其组合是否和谐，而非单根线条本身。
quote: Line‐beauty means harmony of combined lines or the peculiar quality imparted by special treatment.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 构图靠学艺术而非自然
content: 自然本身不会教构图，必须通过研究大师作品与持续创作实践来掌握构图规律，不能指望从写生自然中自动获得。
quote: Nature will not teach him composition.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 艺术无固定法则
content: 艺术家不受限制性法则约束，即使大师也不能干涉其自由；艺术中没有“必须”与“不可”，规则只是参考而非禁令。
quote: there is no “thou shalt” and “thou shalt not” in art.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 鉴赏力不可灌输
content: 艺术鉴赏力无法像信息一样被讲授或通过阅读获得，只能靠训练与练习逐步培养，因此教学应以培养鉴赏力为基础。
quote: This power cannot be imparted like information. Artistic skill cannot be given by dictation or acquired by reading.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 替代材料可练线
content: 若无法获得或不使用日本画材，可用铅笔、炭笔、水彩、蜡笔乃至油画颜料完成线条与块面练习。
quote: the exercises can be carried on with pencil, charcoal, water colors, crayons, and even oil paint.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 水平线两端等高
content: 若直线AB位于水平面内，则其两个端点的垂直距离（高度）必须相同，即AC等于BC′。
quote: If the line _AB_ is in a horizontal plane, the vertical distance of one of its extremities must be the same as that of the other.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 线描工具不宜做调子
content: 蚀刻针、钢笔、铅笔属于线描工具，用它们作画时不应试图表现调子与阴影；工具决定作品性格，充分发挥工具与材料的可能性才能得到最佳效果。
quote: Etching, pen drawing and pencil sketching are line‐arts. The needle, pen and lead pencil are tools for drawing lines

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 平面定位需两线
content: 要确定一个平面在画面中的空间位置，必须先给出该平面内的两条直线；只有一条线无法固定平面，构图时至少找两条共面参考线（如地平线与墙角线）来建立透视。
quote: As in order to fix the position of a line two points in it must be given, so in order to fix the position of a plane, two lines in it must be given.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 线条呼应的构图平衡
content: 让主体形成的线条（如行军队列线）与画面中另一条自然线条（如树冠线）走向呼应，形成线条层面的平衡关系。
quote: the balance between the line described by the leading company of soldiers and the line of tree tops on the wooded hill

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 线条的连续与呼应
content: 让画面中某一部分成为相邻或对应部分的线索：用相似曲线上下衔接、平滑过渡，使观众一眼看出各部分之间的平衡关系。
quote: any one part of the whole is a kind of key to some adjoining or corresponding part

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 边框与中心的反差
content: 设计带边框与中心的图案时，两者必须形成差异，可用两值实现：黑底白纹对白底黑纹，或小纹样边框配单一大型中心纹样。
quote: Border and centre must differ, and there are many ways of doing this even in two values

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 长线穿行画面的走法
content: 设计长线时让它从画面一角（如右下角）起，依次穿过若干中间元素（动物、道具、车轮轴心、人群头顶），再沿边缘（田边、树篱）微降滑行，最后从画面另一端（左端）穿出，形成贯穿全幅的连续轨迹。
quote: It begins, in fact, with the feet of the donkey at the lower right-hand corner of the frame

source_ref.title: Pictorial Beauty on the Screen
source_ref.author: Freeburg, Victor Oscar, 1882-1953; Ingram, Rex, 1892-1950 [Author of introduction, etc.]

title: 整体性优先于突出
content: 评判构图时，若某一部分过于突出以致其余部分失去存在理由，作品的整体性就被破坏；线条可多可少，但每条都必须服务于整体。
quote: If one part is made so prominent that the others have no reason for being there, the art is gone.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 视平线即眼高
content: 过视点S画一条横贯纸面的水平线GH，称为视平线；它代表观者眼睛在整幅画面中的高度，若画面中要表现远处海面或平原的地平线，就用这条线来定义。
quote: This line is of great practical use, representing the level of the eye of the observer all through the picture.

source_ref.title: The Elements of Perspective arranged for the use of schools and intended to be read in connection with the first three books of Euclid
source_ref.author: Ruskin, John, 1819-1900

title: 避免单一要素过久
content: 长时间停留在单一要素上有失去兴趣的危险，应轮换练习线、notan、色彩，以保持学习动力。
quote: There is danger, however, of losing interest by dwelling upon one subject too long.

source_ref.title: Composition
source_ref.author: Dow, Arthur W. (Arthur Wesley), 1857-1922

title: 三分法是指导非硬规则
content: 三分法只是可靠的构图指导原则而非硬性规则，可作为初学者入门的起点，允许按需打破。
quote: Like most other filmmaking “rules,” it’s not really a rule at all — more of a golden guideline.

source_ref.title: The Rule of Thirds
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 对称破格制造张力
content: 当需要把观众视线强行钉在画面中心、制造紧张感时，可以打破三分法，把人物放在正中做完全对称构图；这种破格只在有明确叙事理由时使用。
quote: Gilroy puts Lou in the center of the screen, ignoring the rule of thirds.

source_ref.title: Rules of Shot Composition in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 三分法交点构图
content: 把画面想象成井字棋盘，两条竖线两条横线；拍摄时把主体或兴趣点放在四条线的交点上，比放在正中更悦目，同时交点位置的选择本身就在交代角色在世界中的位置。
quote: As the camera frames your shot, keep the image on the intersecting lines. It’s more pleasing to the eye.

source_ref.title: Rules of Shot Composition in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 双人三分法站位
content: 拍两人同框时，仍画出井字格，把两个角色分别放在交点两侧，使两人各占一条竖线附近，形成平衡又保持间隔。
quote: Put a character on either side of the intersecting lines.

source_ref.title: Rules of Shot Composition in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 地平线置于三分线
content: 拍摄含地平线的镜头时，把地平线放在上方或下方的水平三分线上，而不是居中。
quote: It is also suggested that any horizon is placed on either the top horizontal line or bottom horizontal line.

source_ref.title: The Rule of Thirds
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 构图维持观众投入
content: 掌握并善用构图规则，能让观众从开场到结尾持续保持投入。
quote: Knowing the rules of shot composition and using them well can keep your audience engaged from beginning to end.

source_ref.title: Rules of Shot Composition in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 构图定义
content: 构图指场景元素在摄影机画框内的排列方式；镜头构图则是通过视觉元素的安排来传达特定信息。
quote: Composition refers to the way elements of a scene are arranged in a camera frame.

source_ref.title: Rules of Shot Composition in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 规则可破
content: 构图规则在多数情况下可依赖，但最出彩的用法往往是反其道而行；规则是为被打破而设的。
quote: the rules of composition are made to be broken

source_ref.title: Rules of Shot Composition in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 对称揭示权力关系
content: 用平衡与对称构图时，画面往往用来揭示人物性格与权力关系，例如库布里克在《全金属外壳》《2001太空漫游》中的对称镜头。
quote: They often reveal character traits and power dynamics.

source_ref.title: Rules of Shot Composition in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 侧脸暗示不可信
content: 要塑造不可信、有距离感的角色，让他偏离中心，并且只露出侧脸轮廓而非正脸；观众很少看到正脸的人难以被信任。
quote: In many scenes, Lou is placed off-center and only the side of his face is visible.

source_ref.title: Rules of Shot Composition in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder

title: 偏置构图孤立角色
content: 要表现角色被孤立、与所处世界疏离时，把人物放在画面一侧、远离三分线交点或远离画面中心，用留白把他与周围环境隔开。
quote: Lou appears on the side of the frame, away from the world he exists in.

source_ref.title: Rules of Shot Composition in Film
source_ref.author: StudioBinder
